fact: GNHR data is used as the targeting and verification backbone across 15 government and partner-led social protection programmes in 2019-2026, including LEAP Expansion (Apr 2023), the LEAP reassessment (ongoing), WFP dry-spell targeting (Oct 2024) and a UNICEF-LEAP adolescent girls programme (Oct 2025).
title: Data Usage & Impact | GNHR
publisher: Ghana National Household Registry, Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection
